composite_weights.comment: Top-level category weights - must sum to 1.0

momentum_weights.comment: Individual momentum indicator weights - must sum to 1.0

details.macd: Moving Average Convergence Divergence - trend direction

fundamental_weights.comment: Individual fundamental metric weights - must sum to 1.0

details.valuation: P/E, PEG, P/B ratios - is it fairly priced?
details.profitability: Margins, ROE, ROA - how profitable is the business?
details.financial_health: Debt levels, liquidity, cash flow - can it survive downturns?
details.growth: Revenue and earnings growth - is it expanding?

sentiment_weights.comment: Sentiment analysis component weights - must sum to 1.0

details.base_sentiment: Direct sentiment score from news headline analysis
details.positive_ratio: Proportion of positive vs negative headlines

max_scores.comment: Maximum points for each category (out of 100 total)

notes.momentum: Technical analysis captures price trends and market psychology
notes.fundamental: Financial analysis captures business quality and valuation
notes.sentiment: News sentiment captures market narrative and public perception
notes.backtesting: Historical validation helps optimize weights for predictive power
